question: Will it survive a 1.2 m drop onto concrete with its 45 g battery?

plan.question: Will it survive a 1.2 m drop onto concrete with its 45 g battery?

reasons.decided: handheld.py is a .py file, read as a part (parametric)

steps.headline: Fails a 1.2 m drop onto concrete slab, worst landing -x-y-z corner down: peak von Mises stress 68.1 MPa at (-41.5, -23.2, 0) mm, safety factor 0.91 against 62 MPa (target 2). An accelerometer there reads 2503 g filtered at 10 kHz; the impact itself peaks at 2499 g over 0.704 ms. Confidence is medium.

assumptions.assumed: landing not given, so every face and corner is tried (worst)
